title: Report: Funding, opportunity gaps hurting educational progress in Michigan
summary_en: At an event in Detroit Tuesday morning, EdTrust-Midwest shared many concerning metrics about Michigan schools. Leaders say the state must invest deeply into districts with high concentrations of poverty and lean into literacy reforms to see change.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Report: Funding, opportunity gaps hurting educational progress in Michigan

title: Parents of Michigan students with disabilities demand special education reforms
summary_en: More than 75 people attended a meeting Monday night focused on what the state can do to improve special education. Many shared personal stories of their students.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Parents of Michigan students with disabilities demand special education reforms
